added_lines: bill croston, anniversary fri. 23rd 10:00am conor lordan, anniversary bridget cullinane, i. we rememb er harry lande and ann harding and ronan baxter who died recently. confessions on saturday at 4:30pm or by appointment. cleaning our church like any building, needs regular cleaning and it has been the tradition in this parish that volunteers clean the church weekly. we are grateful to all those who, over many years have generously given of their time to meet this ministry. we appeal each year for volunteers, (male and female) but it is a challenge to find parishioners eager to serve this ministry. the church cleaning task takes one hour on a saturday morning. we currently have 2 teams which means each team does one hour every 2 weeks. if you can help, please contact the parish office. thank you. thursday coffee mornings are back after 10:00am mass. all . choir: our church choir has returned and we welcome them back. as always, new members are very welcome. practice is on tuesday nights from 7:30 – 9:00pm. no auditions! october: talks on faith the best kept secrets of our catholic faith following on from the talks by fr. kevin ogorman sma entitled' a wholesome faith for today' and'"jesus and his teaching on the kingdom of god" there will be two more talks on thursday 22nd and 29th of october covering; 22nd october: fr. sylvester on the theme of " hope for november" and on29th october fr. kevin on "pope leo xiv recent encyclical on catholic social teaching, and our human dignity" the talks will start at 7.30pm in the parish meeting room. there will be time for a cup of tea and discussion after. all are welcome. reflection: lord, make my heart a haven where the lonely may find friendship, where the weary may find shelter, where the helpless may find refuge, where the hopeless may find hope, where all those who seek someone who cares, may enter and find you waiting there. the working document for the irish national synodal assembly, taking place in gormanston, co meath, on 17 october, brings together the fruits of five years of prayer, listening and discernment and will guide delegates as they consider and vote on suggested actions to be presented to the bishops of ireland. while the assembly marks an important moment in the journey, the synodal pathway is now moving towards a new phase of implementation. everyone is invited to read, pray with, and reflect on the working document and the question: “what does god want from the church in ireland at this time?” please pray for all those taking part in the assembly and for the guidance of the holy spirit. prayer: for the church in ireland as we journey towards the national synodal assembly on 17 october: may the holy spirit guide all those preparing for and taking part in the assembly, giving them wisdom to listen, courage to discern and openness to god’s call, so that together we may respond faithfully to what god is asking of the church at this time. lord, hear us. information on:

facebook: @harbourparishchurch es @carrigalineparish @stbrigid’schurch instagr am: @carrigalineparish 18. oct.26 h crosshaven parish tracton mass times: sat. vigil mass at 6.00om. sun. mass at 10.00am. daily masses on tues. and fri. at 10.00am. this week's gospel centres on the question of the c oin and the taxes. the religious leaders thought they had corne red jesus with a political question. " is it lawful to pay census tax to caesar or not?" if jesus said "yes" he would seem to be endorsing the roman oppressors and if he said "no" he would be guilty o f sedition against rome. jesus asked to see a roman coin. it bore the head o f caesar. he replied "then repay to caesar what belongs to caesar and repay to god what belongs to god". a coin bears caesar’s image and it returns to him. humans, however are made in the image and likeness of god. thus, our identity, our whole lives belong to god. first year students from coláiste muire marked the beginning of their secondary school journey recently with a beautiful mass celebrated in prayer and song. we wish them every blessing during their years in coláiste muire . healing mass confessions reminder that confessions take place every saturday after the 11.30am mass. autumn stations - the autumn station masses are continuing. we had two beautiful ceremonies during the week with fr. michael on monday evening and fr. james on wednesday evening. our parishioners are very grateful to the m for celebrating the masses and joining them for some light refreshments and chat afterwards. our final autumn station is on wednesday next at 7.30pm. in st. patrick’s church, nohoval. tracton g. a. a. wishing every success to our junior bhurlers who play coursey rovers in the south east f inal at 11.30am on sunday. parish mass times sundays at minane bridge 10.00am. sundays at nohoval 11.15am. a prayer for pope leo xiv we keep pope leo in our thoughts and prayers following his recent cancer diagnosis and surgery. in a message to a vatican conference, the holy fath er entrusted those gathered to the protection of the holy family of nazareth and asked them to pray for him, saying: “entrusting each of you to the protection of the holy family of nazareth, i ask you please to pray for me , as i pray for you.” let us respond to his request by praying for his st rength, healing and a full recovery. may the lord guide those caring for him, and may jesus, mary and joseph surround with their loving protection, bringing him comfort, peace and renewed health during this difficult time. at this time, we are also mindful of the many people in our own families and communities facing similar challen ges — those preparing for or recovering from iting tests or difficult results, undergoing cancer treatment, or anxiously waiting for treatment to begin. we hold them all in our prayers. lord, hear our prayer carrigaline
